text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the owner broke the law.** Satellite data detected 86.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in qualifying events after 2020: 81.3 hectares in 2021, 0.6 in 2022 and 4.5 in 2023. Most of each event overlapped areas mapped as forest in 2020.

Tree-cover loss alone does not establish who caused it, why it occurred, or whether it was unlawful. A legal assessment would require the applicable rules, land and forest classification, permits, and evidence of the cause and responsibility.
